notes.title: Reworked First Map and Greek Map Update 07/05/2021
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Bd_6-LW4RsE;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to all of the technologies we developed, we now have the ability to bring new improvements to Stand Out.
Today we are bringing you the very first map completely reworked for better graphics and better performances!
And not only that but we also reworked the Greek map with more details and a more interesting level design!
There are still some little things to be polished out, but we wanted you to be able to enjoy it for this week end!

Expect more to come soon! :wink:

notes.title: Out of Early Access Update 18/5/2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31284964/5ea1074fcb566e9b3d94c7ed22caa83e12efd3c7.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, thank you so much for playing Stand Out and thank you for your help with its development. After all this time, Stand Out is finally ready for its final release and is available on Steam and the Oculus Store with cross-play multiplayer!

We want you to know that we are not done with improving Stand Out and that a new map is currently being developed as well as other new contents! Join us on discord to get informed in real time of our progress : https://discord.gg/xhs9br

Todays update include a revert to the previous squad system as you requested it, but with this time a lower penalty on HP.

Other fixes:

- Better item positioning in the hands
- Hand disappearing when a held grenade explodes fixed
- Direction Circle disappearing on HTC Vive fixed

tags.bug: - Hand disappearing when a held grenade explodes fixed

notes.title: Update 16/5/2019 Hand Animations and New Squad Rules!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31284964/de7370e08ce418793da33e5d358f99dae47247d6.png[/img]

Hi everyone, thank you for playing Stand Out!

Hands now adapt correctly their position to the weapon.

We also changed how the squad system works, there is no HP handicap anymore, but if someone dies on your squad,
everybody lose, so take care of your squad mates! 

we did so because we wanted to keep some balance between non-squaded players and squaded players
while fixing the fact that when one of your teammate dies, it's too annoying for them to be kicked out of the action.
This way you never have to wait for your teammates to finish, and it keeps the game balanced without the disliked HP handicap.

Other Fixes:

- Multiple colliders adjustments
- Multiple Texture fixes
- New Forest Sound
- Random Death bug fixed
- Vehicle teleporting bug fixed
- Glitched spawn loot fixed
- second hand hold to grab fixed
- Weird crashes on certain locations fixed
- Menu text size adjusted
- Throwing grenade/objects is now easier
- Sound glitches removed (or at least reduced)

tags.feature: Hands now adapt correctly their position to the weapon.
We also changed how the squad system works, there is no HP handicap anymore, but if someone dies on your squad, everybody lose, so take care of your squad mates!

See you soon in game.

- The music in the menu can be deactivated
- Slightly more weapons
- Minor graphics improvement
- Fire mode switch fixed
- Controller displaying bug fixed
- Easter Eggs
- Anti cheat improvements
- You can now see who killed you on the end panel, so that you can report suspicious behaviours and get cheaters banned

notes.title: Update 03/12/2017

- Wrong distances bug fixed
- Hand lost/stolen bug fixed
- Wrong player count in the end bug fixed
- Invisible player bug should be fixed
- Grab issues with second hand fixed
- Free hand on aim option renamed "proximity grab" for better understanding
- Players being stuck in a black room bug should be fixed
- Sound optimisation and minor improvements
- MP5 has been buffed (was too inneficient at 100meters)
- Beaches have been improved graphically
- Port villages have improved in level design and in quality
- New explorable lighthouses
- Better resolution for grass and rocks
- Ambiant Particles Effects have been added on parkings and on water

notes.title: Update 29/11/2017
notes.content:
- People being kicked back to the menu on the plane fixed
- Connection failed to waiting room fixed
- Left handed mode added
- You can now enable/disable the autogrip
- The gun smoothing can be enabled/disabled
- The 180° mode can be enabled/disabled
- The weapon angle can be adjusted
- Invincible player bug fixed
- Invisible player fixed
- More realistic ragdolls
- Weapons inflict more damages
- Bullet impacts are more visible from afar
- More feedbacks on the enemies hit (more visible blood splatters)
- Feet should not be visible/shootable through ceilings
- The voice chat can be muted
- Addition of supermarkets and hospitals on the map
- Less floating houses on the map
- You cannot move up with the parachute anymore
- Transition between games is smoother
- Improved game haptics
- Minor improvements on the sound design
- The scopes stay active all the time
- It is not possible to wall hack with the scopes anymore
- You can now kill people by running over them with vehicles (if you go fast enough)
- The barrier has been slowed down
- Graphics improvements in the menu
- Score system with unlockable loot crates
- LOD issues fixed on the players
- Large buildings textures have been improved
- You can now use the touchpad locomotion with the two hands
- Better distribution of the vehicles and weapons on the map
